spec.title: application-core Phase 5: the user's allocation bounds (basket-first-claim 2, checked-claim 3), the joint acceptance and the contract with no case held
spec.description: The user decided the two frozen claims' allocation bounds on 2026-11-08: lib/tests/fixtures/application-core/golden/basket-first-claim.json now bounds each version's allocations at 2 (was 0) and checked-claim.json at 3 (was 1), because the allocation gate counts the exceptions a call may throw, as the user's earlier O3 decision did. Under the old bounds copied-first and alias-to-copy were left unresolved where expected.json says refuted on identity; the contract (lib/tests/application_core.rs) and the joint acceptance (lib/tests/application_core_joint.rs) held those two cases to the gate's outcome. They now hold every case to expected.json. This job runs the whole joint acceptance (J1 with its R2 and O2 parts, H, L, J2), the contract and tests/value_parameters.rs in release on the own checker, with a jbmc first on PATH that records being called; the last step fails if any check called it. expected.json is unchanged. When it passes, O2, V2 and J1 of llm-dlc/loops/application-core.md pass and Phase 5 is done.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: all six joint tests, the contract's 14 and value_parameters' 10 pass, and the last step finds no call of jbmc
